tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience in Government departments auditing above 500 cr. Budget in last 3 years.

The tenderer shall have minimum 05 years of experience as statutory auditors or internal auditors of Government undertakings or private or Charitable institutions having turnover of not less than Rs. 500 Crores per annum during a block period of last 05 years. The applicant shall upload the documents for proof of experience or work done certificate issued by the Government undertakings or private or Charitable institutions.
